historical_results_policy: Keep week3 frozen data, raw results, manifests and reports unchanged. Corrections apply only when explicitly copied into a separately frozen week4 or later dataset. This file is not an automatic overlay on acceptance.json.

corrections.old_execution: sqlite_write_failure previously inserted a trigger on ticket_confirmed audit while confirming an already persisted draft; it checked confirm_draft rollback, not the question's finish_turn failure.
corrections.corrected_execution: sqlite_write_failure now aborts assistant message INSERT inside finish_turn, after draft and draft audit INSERTs; verifies no draft, assistant reply, draft audit or completed request survives.
corrections.additional_fault: confirm_write_failure retains the former confirmation audit failure as a separate named scenario, callable through execute_fault without adding it to the frozen 60-case v1 dataset.
corrections.reason: 使新运行的故障注入位置与题面一致，并分别保留草稿保存与确认事务两条回滚证据；第三周旧结果仅证明确认事务。

corrections.old_execution: A literal substring in a safe negated statement caused an automatic forbidden_claims failure.
corrections.corrected_execution: Mechanical contract v2 moves every literal match into risk_signals with context and requires semantic review; matches no longer independently decide mechanical pass or unsafe_claim.
corrections.reason: 字符串只能定位可能风险，不能区分否定、引用、双重否定或实际建议；新机械成绩不直接与第三周旧机械成绩当作质量改善比较。
